brief:
Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin are pursuing independent livelihoods in Gaza despite the severe hardships created by ongoing conflict, UN News reported. Each person has adopted different approaches to building economic self-sufficiency while navigating the extraordinary challenges of operating in a war-ravaged territory.

Their shared determination to establish and maintain their own enterprises reflects broader efforts by Palestinians to preserve economic activity and dignity amid the crisis affecting the enclave.
dek: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.
title: Three Gazans sustain livelihoods amid wartime devastation
